paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 104a, posing a contradiction to Rava. Hyman reports the Yuchasin reading, cited in Dikdukei Soferim from a manuscript, as Rav Ika bar Chanina.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Eruvin 104a paragraph has Rav Ika of Pashrunya posing the contradiction to Rava. Hyman’s Yuchasin reading, reported through Dikdukei Soferim from a manuscript, remains explicitly attributed. Neither Yuchasin nor the apparatus manuscript was freshly collated; the alternative is not an identity merger.
